text: Supervisor, workers and the tools they see

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Self-rebuilding workers improve continuity, while remaining subordinate to the end-to-end loop.
Idle-agent guidance is a completed enabling mechanism with limited independent mission value.
Reliable supervisor communication supports continuity but is not the primary autonomy outcome.
Timeout reliability supports the loop without defining its capability.
The completed watchdog UI is supporting observability rather than autonomy itself.
Mission-path context is enabling infrastructure for coherent autonomous decisions.
Accurate concise tool descriptions reduce execution errors but have indirect autonomy impact.

status.comment: All grouped children are implemented; this idea only groups them (regrouping of crowded parents, 2026-11-16).
